passages.text: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go; because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is God.
The LORD said, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh.
I will act with My mighty hand.
Pharaoh will let the people go because of My power.
Pharaoh will drive them out of his land because of My strong hand.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה תִרְאֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְפַרְעֹ֑ה כִּ֣י בְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ יְשַׁלְּחֵ֔ם וּבְיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה יְגָרְשֵׁ֖ם מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: God also told Moses, “I am the LORD.
passages.sermon: God spoke to Moses.\r\nGod said to Moses, “I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God said, “I am the LORD.”
God appeared to Abraham.
God appeared to Isaac.
God appeared to Jacob.
God appeared to them as God Almighty.
God did not make Himself known to them by His name, the LORD.
passages.original: וָאֵרָ֗א אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל־ יִצְחָ֥ק וְאֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּאֵ֣ל שַׁדָּ֑י וּשְׁמִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖עְתִּי לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God is the LORD.
God made a covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God promised to give them the land of Canaan.
Canaan is the land where they lived as foreigners.
passages.original: וְגַ֨ם הֲקִמֹ֤תִי אֶת־ בְּרִיתִי֙ אִתָּ֔ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֵ֛ת אֶ֥רֶץ מְגֻרֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ גָּ֥רוּ בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is the LORD.
God has a covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The Israelites are Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob’s descendants.
The Egyptians are forcing the Israelites to be slaves.
The Israelites are groaning because of their suffering.
God has heard the groaning of the Israelites.
God remembers His covenant.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם׀ אֲנִ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶֽת־ נַאֲקַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם מַעֲבִדִ֣ים אֹתָ֑ם וָאֶזְכֹּ֖ר אֶת־ בְּרִיתִֽי׃

passages.text: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
God said, "I am the LORD."
God said, "I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians."
The Egyptians forced the Israelites to work as slaves.
God said, "I will deliver you from their bondage."
God said, "I will redeem you with an outstretched arm."
God said, "I will redeem you with mighty acts of judgment."
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֥ר לִבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְהוֹצֵאתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ סִבְלֹ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְגָאַלְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבִשְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃

passages.text: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God said, “I am the LORD.
I will take you as My own people.
I will be your God.
You will know that I am the LORD your God.
I am the one who brings you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.”
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֥ם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם הַמּוֹצִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת סִבְל֥וֹת מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD!’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God is the LORD.
God promised to give a land to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God swore to give this land to them.
God said, “I will bring you into this land.”
God said, “I will give this land to you as your possession.”
God said, “I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֣ת אֹתָ֔הּ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֹתָ֥הּ לָכֶ֛ם מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke these words to the Israelites.
The Israelites did not listen to Moses.
Their spirit was broken.
Their labor was harsh and cruel.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה כֵּ֖ן אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִקֹּ֣צֶר ר֔וּחַ וּמֵעֲבֹדָ֖ה קָשָֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: So the LORD said to Moses, “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Go to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
Speak to Pharaoh.
Tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites leave his land.
Tell Pharaoh to send the Israelites out of Egypt.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ בֹּ֣א דַבֵּ֔ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וִֽישַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “If the Israelites will not listen to me, then why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I am unskilled in speech?”
passages.sermon:
Moses stood before the LORD.
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses said, “The Israelites did not listen to me.
Why would Pharaoh listen to me?
I am unskilled in speech.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֤ן בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְאֵיךְ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣נִי פַרְעֹ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י עֲרַ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
The LORD gave Moses and Aaron a command.
The LORD commanded them about the Israelites.
The LORD commanded them about Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
The LORD told them to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ וַיְצַוֵּם֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
passages.sermon:
Reuben was the firstborn son of Israel.
Reuben had sons named Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
These sons became the heads of their families.
These families formed the clans of Reuben.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֲנ֤וֹךְ וּפַלּוּא֙ חֶצְר֣וֹן וְכַרְמִ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת רְאוּבֵֽן׃

passages.text: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
passages.sermon:
Simeon was a son of Israel.
Simeon had several sons.
His sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, and Zohar.
Simeon also had a son named Shaul.
Shaul’s mother was a Canaanite woman.
These men became the clans of Simeon.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֨ל וְיָמִ֤ין וְאֹ֙הַד֙ וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֔חַר וְשָׁא֖וּל בֶּן־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃

passages.text: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
passages.sermon:
Levi was a son of Jacob.
Levi had three sons.
Their names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
These are the names of Levi’s sons according to their records.
Levi lived 137 years.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ לֵוִי֙ לְתֹ֣לְדֹתָ֔ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִ֑י וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י לֵוִ֔י שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
passages.sermon:
Gershon was a son of Levi.
Gershon had two sons.
Their names were Libni and Shimei.
Libni and Shimei became the heads of their own clans.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֛וֹן לִבְנִ֥י וְשִׁמְעִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
passages.sermon:
Kohath was a son of Levi.
Kohath had four sons.
Their names were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kohath lived 133 years.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵ֑ל וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י קְהָ֔ת שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites according to their records.
passages.sermon:
Merari was a son of Levi.
Merari had two sons.
Their names were Mahli and Mushi.
Mahli and Mushi became the ancestors of clans.
These clans belonged to the Levites.
The Levites kept records of their clans.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְתֹלְדֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
passages.sermon:
Amram was a son of Kohath.
Amram married Jochebed.
Jochebed was Amram’s father’s sister.
Jochebed became Amram’s wife.
Jochebed gave birth to Aaron.
Jochebed gave birth to Moses.
Amram lived 137 years.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח עַמְרָ֜ם אֶת־ יוֹכֶ֤בֶד דֹּֽדָתוֹ֙ ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י עַמְרָ֔ם שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
passages.sermon: Izhar was a Levite.\r\nIzhar had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יִצְהָ֑ר קֹ֥רַח וָנֶ֖פֶג וְזִכְרִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
passages.sermon: Uzziel was a man from the tribe of Levi.\r\nUzziel had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִֽישָׁאֵ֥ל וְאֶלְצָפָ֖ן וְסִתְרִֽי׃

passages.text: And Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was a leader of the Israelites.
Aaron married Elisheba.
Elisheba was the daughter of Amminadab.
Elisheba was the sister of Nahshon.
Elisheba became Aaron’s wife.
Elisheba gave birth to four sons for Aaron.
Their sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ אֱלִישֶׁ֧בַע בַּת־ עַמִּינָדָ֛ב אֲח֥וֹת נַחְשׁ֖וֹן ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־ נָדָב֙ וְאֶת־ אֲבִיה֔וּא אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־ אִֽיתָמָֽר׃

passages.text: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the clans of the Korahites.
passages.sermon: Korah had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph.\r\nThese three sons became the ancestors of the Korahite clans.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קֹ֔רַח אַסִּ֥יר וְאֶלְקָנָ֖ה וַאֲבִיאָסָ֑ף אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקָּרְחִֽי׃

passages.text: Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families by their clans.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was the son of Aaron.
Eleazar married a woman from the daughters of Putiel.
She became his wife.
She gave birth to Phinehas.
These men were the leaders of the Levite families.
They led their clans.
passages.original: וְאֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן לָקַֽח־ ל֨וֹ מִבְּנ֤וֹת פּֽוּטִיאֵל֙ ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־ פִּֽינְחָ֑ס אֵ֗לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.”
passages.sermon:
Aaron and Moses were brothers.
Aaron and Moses were Levites.
The LORD spoke to Aaron and Moses.
The LORD gave them a command.
The LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of Egypt.”
The LORD told them to lead the Israelites out by their divisions.
passages.original: ה֥וּא אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֜יאוּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־ צִבְאֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron were brothers.
God chose Moses and Aaron.
Moses and Aaron spoke to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Moses and Aaron spoke to Pharaoh for God.
God sent Moses and Aaron to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
Moses and Aaron led the Israelites out of Egypt.
passages.original: הֵ֗ם הַֽמְדַבְּרִים֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם ה֥וּא מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

passages.text: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt, He said to him, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt.
This happened on a certain day.
The LORD said to Moses, "I am the LORD."
The LORD told Moses, "Speak to Pharaoh."
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
The LORD commanded Moses, "Tell Pharaoh everything I say to you."
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּי֨וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דַּבֵּ֗ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “Since I am unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
passages.sermon:
Moses stood before the LORD.
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses said, “I am unskilled in speech.”
Moses asked, “Why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ עֲרַ֣ל שְׂפָתַ֔יִם וְאֵ֕יךְ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵלַ֖י פַּרְעֹֽה׃פ
